comments.author: tjohn327
comments.body:
Thanks Nico. This PR targets the old combined draft (draft-scion-svcb.md), which has since been replaced by draft-john-scion-svcb.md, so I’m closing it. The points are carried over:

“interoperable way”: adopted.
SCION AS vs BGP AS: adopted. The term is now “SCION AS number” (CP 1.5.2), with a scoping sentence as in CP 1.1. It is used in full where the format is defined, as in CP.
Text representation: the ISD-AS part now cites CP 1.5.3 / 1.5.3.1 / 1.5.3.2. The full address uses “_” as separator, so it can’t cite 1.5.3.3 directly.
“MUST ignore”: the current text already names the actor, and it rejects the RRset as RFC 9460 Sec 2.2 requires.
“extends”: the HEv3 material has moved to a separate draft. This draft no longer claims to extend anything.
IANA TODO: done. The section now names the SvcParamKeys registry.

Feedback we often get was to clearly separate wording for SCION ASes and normal BGP ASes. 
You can also reuse the terminology in the main SCION drafts and refer to it.

I would not say you extend another IETF standards track document.. This doe not work unless oyu are adopted by a WG.. 
You could say "proposes". 

However, I feel this document is defining two different things (happy eyeballs, and SVCB records, which I feel belong to two different drafts
Here you would have to mention what registries  you want :)
